sections.text: A conditional planning estimate is available. It depends on the accepted assumptions and is not a guarantee of production performance. This is a planning view for a factory size based on accepted assumptions. It is not a promise of how the factory will perform in production.

The workload estimate is 16 GPUs. The selected factory deployment anchor is 256 GPUs. These are different quantities. HGX_B300: 16 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 16 to 16). HGX_B200: 16 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 16 to 16). HGX_H200: 16 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 16 to 16). Counts use whole GPU nodes. Spare compute does not establish an admitted tenant count. Sensitivity is not a confidence interval. The factory size is a planning anchor while the workload estimate is separate. Spare room can exist without identifying who may use it.

Required memory per GPU: 58.359738 GB. Selected hardware memory per GPU: 288 GB. Host RAM provision for the workload: 4096 GB. Host local disk provision: 61440 GB. Host provisions are planning assumptions. Per-device memory fit matters, not just aggregate memory. Working memory needs to fit each device rather than only adding up across the factory. The host memory and local files kept for later are planning assumptions.

No local shared-storage capacity has been established. This is not a zero-storage requirement. An outside corpus is not automatically copied into this factory. Capacity for shared files kept for later is still an open requirement. Outside data is not assumed to be copied in automatically.

External customer datacenter ingress: unresolved. North-south ingress: unresolved. Dedicated storage read/write links: unresolved / unresolved. East-west link per GPU: unresolved. Storage networking is physically dedicated, not converged. External and north-south rates describe the same traffic at different boundaries and must not be added together. These are lower bounds, not selected circuit sizes. Traffic entering the factory and communication between GPUs still need measurements. External and north-south views describe the same flow at different boundaries.

Review assumptions and outstanding measurements with the architect. Prepare or use the saved design handoff together with its companion requirements. Provide the initial customer-datacenter data volume and allowed transfer window. Ongoing bulk transfers are unspecified. Daily-volume rates are averages over 24 hours, not measured burst rates. Measure aggregate storage read and write throughput. Storage capacity alone does not determine fabric bandwidth. East-west per-GPU port demand needs the selected reference design and collective-communication measurements. Customer-datacenter round-trip latency objective is unspecified. A saved projection exists. Fields marked brief_only must be applied separately by the architect. Clarify open requirements with the architect and use the saved handoff. Supply the missing transfer window and volume details for customer data.
